evidence.description: Housing Ombudsman determination records the resident's complaint history, repair reports, and landlord response.

case.facts: The landlord was aware of a damp bedroom wall at the resident’s property since November 2022. It inspected the wall and carried out some works over the next year. The resident complained to the landlord on 6 December 2023 as she said the wall was still damp. The complaint is about the landlord’s handling of the resident’s reports of a damp bedroom wall.
